official_pricing.notes: 2026-11-01 核实的原厂标准价；非 OpenRouter 目录报价。促销截止日期与附加收费以来源为准。
Published pay-as-you-go rates. Service tier, context range and video resolution are retained in each tier; video inputs are billed at output resolution.

billing_expr:
(
  !(
    (
      month("Asia/Shanghai") == 1 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") >= 1 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") <= 3
    ) ||
    (
      month("Asia/Shanghai") == 2 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") >= 15 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") <= 23
    ) ||
    (
      month("Asia/Shanghai") == 4 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") >= 4 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") <= 6
    ) ||
    (
      month("Asia/Shanghai") == 5 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") >= 1 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") <= 5
    ) ||
    (
      month("Asia/Shanghai") == 6 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") >= 19 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") <= 21
    ) ||
    (
      month("Asia/Shanghai") == 9 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") >= 25 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") <= 27
    ) ||
    (
      month("Asia/Shanghai") == 10 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") >= 1 &&
      day("Asia/Shanghai") <= 7
    )
  ) &&
  weekday("Asia/Shanghai") >= 1 &&
  weekday("Asia/Shanghai") <= 5 &&
  (
    (
      hour("Asia/Shanghai") >= 9 &&
      hour("Asia/Shanghai") < 12
    ) ||
    (
      hour("Asia/Shanghai") >= 14 &&
      hour("Asia/Shanghai") < 18
    )
  )
)
? tier("峰时", p * 10 + c * 40 + cr * 0.2)
: tier("谷时", p * 5 + c * 20 + cr * 0.1)

official_pricing.notes: (2) Off-peak rates are half of the peak rates. Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays. All other hours are off-peak, including weekends and Chinese public holidays in full.
